title: Primer
description: Frontmatter contract for a capability primer under docs/primers/.

topic.description: Marks a concept primer (how models work) that explains an idea rather than a capability tag. It needs a title and has no capability or label, so it never appears in the capability taxonomy.

title.description: Display title of a concept primer.

label.description: Display label for this capability tag (e.g. 'Image Generation'). Single source of truth for the taxonomy table and every generated index.

aliases.description: Other capability tags this primer covers. Lets one primer serve several enum values (e.g. multimodal-models covers 'vision').

description.description: What this alias tag means, when it differs from the primer's own one_line. Defaults to the primer's.

one_line.description: Short pitch used in the repo README taxonomy table.

learn_more.description: At most 3 curated resources. Prefer learn.microsoft.com URLs.
